bull_bear.body: - Funded entirely from internal accruals; **net cash, no leverage plans** unless big-ticket global acquisition fructifies. (No specific dividend payout discussed on call — flag.) Maharatna status (greater autonomy on investment/JV decisions) now qualified.
bull_bear.title: Capital Allocation (PSU)

bull_bear.body:
- **Iron-ore price:** realization slightly down ~2%, range-bound; lag in passing on steel-price strength (multi-variable pricing, monthly review).
- **Evacuation constraint:** 100 MT impossible without further rail doubling beyond Jagdalpur; 60 MT covered.
- **Receivables:** NSL ~INR1,800 cr outstanding (from INR2,500; ~16-18 mo to clear at INR100 cr/mo); RINL credit via bill-discounting (45-day lag, 100% honored so far, slow liquidation) — "cannot afford not to supply" (7-8 MT/yr customer).
- **Captive-vs-merchant:** big customers (JSW/AMNS/JSPL) developing own mines but still need NMDC's low-P ore as blend — mgmt confident demand intact even at 100 MT.
- **Regulatory:** EC/CTO/forest clearances continuous process (Deposit 13, Rohne pending); MPAP caps in Karnataka.
- **Wage revision** (non-exec pending ministry; exec from 1/1/27) — provided for, claimed marginal.
- **Critical-mineral/RE & overseas M&A:** speculative, profitability unpredictable, execution uncertain.
bull_bear.title: Risks

bull_bear.body: Highly confident/expansive (CMD-led); strong on volume and 100 MT vision, repeatedly "demand never a problem," "selling 100 MT not a big deal." Candid on margin optics (steel one-off), receivables, and that critical-mineral economics are speculative. Maharatna pride. Director-Finance brief, reinforcing 20-30% growth and diversification.
bull_bear.title: Management Tone

bull_bear.body:
- Consol EBITDA optically collapsed 42→33% purely from **pass-through HR-coil trading for NSL** — a one-time cash bridge, NOT margin erosion; core iron-ore margin unchanged at 42%. Watch reported margin snap back in FY27.
- "Branded iron ore" + DR-grade pellet are quiet premium/mix-shift levers India has never had — potential structural realization upside beyond commodity price.
- Low-phosphorus (0.05%) ore = blend-essential even for customers with captive mines — durable demand moat.
- 100 MT is rail-gated, not resource/demand-gated — logistics (rail doubling) is the true binding constraint.
- Coal (Tokisud thermal now; Rohne 8 MT coking by Q3) + rare-earth subsidiary are nascent new P&L legs largely unmodelled.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious Takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- "Total Investments" in subsidiaries, JVs and associates of Rs 1,419.98 crore, plus an investment in a co-operative society of Rs 0.02 crore.
- Holdings listed: Legacy Iron Ore 92.84% at Rs 443.34 cr; NCL 51% at Rs 402.99 cr; ICVL 25.94% at Rs 378.86 cr; BRPL 52% at Rs 152.67 cr; Krishnapatnam Rly Co. Ltd 6.40% at Rs 40.0 cr; NCF at Rs 2 cr; KVSL 100% at Rs 0.10 cr.
- JKMDC is shown at 95.86% and footnoted "(*) Investment derated".
- Treasury remains sizeable but shrinking as an earnings contributor: Interest Income from Deposits with Banks of Rs 553 crore in 9M FY26 versus Rs 774 crore in 9M FY25 (-29%), and Rs 193 crore in Q3 FY26 versus Rs 266 crore (-27%).
- The deck states no dividend, buyback, debt or capex-funding policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Iron-ore (core):** ~42% EBITDA, low-phosphorus (0.05%) ore — structural moat; demand "never a problem" (JSW, AMNS, JSPL, NSL, Raipur secondary cluster expanding).
- **Pellets:** KIOCL job-work, FY26 ~2.4-2.6 MT → FY27 3-3.3 MT; achieved 66.5% FE, targeting 67% **DR-grade pellet (first in India)**, $20-30/t premium. Bacheli-Nagarnar 15 MT slurry pipeline + Nagarnar pellet plant + Bacheli grinding mill commissioning Jun-end/mid-Jul.
- **Steel:** demerged into NSL; only residual = temporary HR-coil trading (one-off).
business.title: Segment

business.body:
- Rail doubling / evacuation works → railway EPC, conveyor/crushing equipment (e.g., downhill conveyors), Vizag blending-yard EPC.
- 15 MT Bacheli-Nagarnar slurry pipeline + pellet plant commissioning → pipeline/pellet-plant EPC vendors.
- ⭐ Branded/blended iron-ore + DR-grade pellet → potential premium realization (NMDC itself).
- (Beneficiary list otherwise sparse — capex largely internal/EPC, vendors not named.)

---
business.title: Challenges → Beneficiaries

business.body:
- State-controlled miner: the President of India holds 5,344,900,713 shares or 60.79%, followed by Life Insurance Corporation of India at 4.97%; the top 25 shareholders together hold 6,704,322,378 shares or 76.26% (as on 30-01-2026).
- Business is presented purely as domestic iron ore — every volume, price and revenue line in the deck is captioned "Iron Ore" or "Average Domestic Realization (Rs./T)"; there is no export, overseas or non-ore segment disclosure.
- Listed on BSE (526371), NSE (NMDC) and The Calcutta Stock Exchange (24131).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Levies] Royalty and statutory levies are a large, separately disclosed cost block: 9M FY26 "Royalty & Other Levies" of Rs 3,681 crore (+16%) plus "Additional Amount (150% of Royalty)" of Rs 4,166 crore (+15%); in Q3 FY26 the same lines were Rs 1,405 crore (flat) and Rs 1,585 crore (-3%).
- [Cost inflation] "Operational Expenses" rose 58% in 9M FY26 to Rs 6,278 crore (from Rs 3,965 crore) and 60% in Q3 FY26 to Rs 2,539 crore (from Rs 1,582 crore) — a faster increase than either volume or revenue growth as reported by the deck.
- [Margin] Deck-stated "EBITDA & Margin (%)" of Rs 7,666 crore (38%) for 9M FY26 against Rs 7,309 crore (44%) for 9M FY25, and Rs 2,504 crore (33%) for Q3 FY26 against Rs 2,783 crore (43%) for Q3 FY25 — margin percentages are the deck's own, not computed here.
- [Disclaimer] The presentation states it "has been prepared by the Company based upon information available in the public domain" and has not been approved or reviewed by any statutory or regulatory authority or stock exchange in India.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- Iron-ore EBITDA structurally ~42-43% (target maintained FY27); consol dip to 33% purely from one-off steel trading.
- Bailadila cost INR1,000 → INR800/ton; further efficiency gains expected to offset wage revisions.
- Coal economics: ~INR500-600 cr revenue per 1 MT (auction-led), 30-40% EBITDA; grade G10.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & Cost

latest_quarter.body: - **Q4 & FY26:** Production 53 MT (>50 MT first time); revenue ~INR31,000 cr; PAT +11%; consol EBITDA 33% (one-off steel trading), iron-ore standalone 42%; realization −2%; cost INR800/t. Maharatna qualified. Deposit 4 opened (50-yr first), coal mine (Jharkhand) opened. **FY27 guidance: 60 MT, 42-43% EBITDA, capex ~INR6,000 cr, CTO 58.8 MT, overseas M&A INR2-3k cr.** Rail doubling completion Dec'26. New rare-earth subsidiary + GMDC MOU. Branded-iron-ore (Vizag INR3,000 cr) + DR-grade pellet (67% FE, $20-30/t premium) initiatives launched.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ / Tracking Log

outlook.body:
- **Volume target FY27: 60 MT total** (NMDC standalone ~58.5 MT + Deposit 4 ~1 MT + Deposit 13 ~0.5 MT). Bridge from 53 MT: Deposit 14 +1, NMZ +1, Kumaraswamy +1.3 (MPAP 8.6→10), Deposit 5 +2 (10→12) = +5.3 MT. **Run-rate already tracking:** first 2 months FY27 ~10 MT (+15% YoY vs ~8.2); crossed **5.3 MT in a single month** (vs 4.4 LY) — first-ever >5 MT month.
- **EBITDA target FY27: ~42-43%** (consol, ex one-off steel trading). Iron-ore realization range-bound — "no volatility either upside or downside" this quarter; price revisited monthly.
- **EC/CTO:** EC capacity 64.8 MT; CTO 55.4 MT, seeking +3.32 → ~58.8 MT CTO target for FY27.
- **Capex FY27: ~INR6,000 cr** (mgmt: "INR6,000 cr more realistic," up to 7,000); **FY28-30: INR7,000-10,000 cr/yr** ("magic figure" INR9-10k cr). Total ~INR40,000-50,000 cr over 3 yrs to hit 100 MT. Major tenders worth INR15,000-20,000 cr to be awarded by next month.
- **Evacuation/logistics:** Kirandul-Bacheli rail doubling — 131 km, 2 sections left (one this month-end, Bhansi-Bacheli by Dec). Lifts rail capacity 28-30 → ~40 MT immediately, then 50-60 MT post Jagdalpur doubling (railway-funded). **60 MT achievable on current rail; 100 MT NOT without further doubling.**
- **Overseas M&A capex FY27: INR2,000-3,000 cr** on asset acquisition abroad; "couple of assets" hoped this year (confidential).
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)

outlook.body:
- **Deposit 4** (NCL/NMDC-CMDC, 51%): opened after 50 yrs; commercial mining from July (Q2); FY27 ~1 MT → 2 MT next yr → 7 MT peak in ~1.5-2 yrs.
- **Deposit 13:** awaiting clearances; start ~Q2 post-monsoon; FY27 ~0.5 MT → 2 MT next yr → peak 10 MT, ramp to 20-21 MT in 4-5 yrs.
- **Deposit 5:** downhill conveyor bottleneck commissioning Jun-end/Jul → 12 MT; long-term 12 → 20 MT.
- **Kirandul** 21 MT → 30 MT by end-decade; **Bacheli** ~18-19 MT → 35 MT; **Kumaraswamy (Karnataka)** stabilizes ~17 MT (regulatory cap).
- **Coal — Tokisud** (thermal, 2.3 MT peak): hit coal seam by Q2, FY27 ~0.75-1 MT. **Rohne** (coking, 8 MT peak): opens ~end-Q3 FY27, no commercial production this year (OB removal). Both open-cast, Hazaribagh/Barkagaon, 12 km apart. Coal topline target ~INR5,000-8,000 cr in 3 yrs.
outlook.title: Production / Pipeline (mine-wise)

outlook.body:
- **Path to 100 MT** by end-decade (mgmt: "110 if not 100").
- **Branded/blended iron ore** — board-sanctioned ~INR3,000 cr blending yard at Vizag (~half of ~1,100-acre parcel); first-in-India consistent-spec ore à la Rio (RTX/RTF), BHP (Newman/Jimblebar), Vale (IOCJ); ~2-2.5 yr build; expected premium "game changer."
- **Vizag land parcel (~1,100 acres, RINL lease ~INR1,500 cr / 1,800 acres):** blending yard + future pellet plant + lithium refinery / critical-mineral processing zone; coastal-shipping access to western markets + local captive (RINL, Ankapalli, Steel Exchange).
- **Critical minerals / rare-earths:** new dedicated subsidiary; GMDC MOU (Gujarat RE mine, JV development + processing); main thrust OVERSEAS — "aggressively scouting," profitability unpredictable.
- **Overseas:** couple of assets in advanced acquisition stages (confidential); Australia gold (Legacy) curtailed to break-even, pivoting to exploration + own refinery plan.
- **Exports:** uneconomic on ore (30% export duty); only pellets make sense.
outlook.title: Growth / Optionality

deepdive.thesis: India's largest iron-ore miner is in an aggressive volume-led expansion (53 MT FY26 → 60 MT guided FY27 → 100 MT by end-decade) funded entirely from internal accruals, while layering optionality from coal, rare-earths/critical minerals, overseas M&A and a first-in-India "branded/blended iron ore" play, with the steel business now demerged (NSL) and turning profitable.

open.item: 15 mt Bacheli-Nagarnar slurry pipeline + Nagarnar pellet plant + Bacheli grinding mill to be commissioned by end June / mid-July 2026 (pre-commissioning trials on).
Rohne coking coal block (8 mt peak) to open ~end Q3FY27; no commercial production this year (overburden removal).
KK line doubling final two sections: one by this month-end, Bhansi-Bacheli by December; capacity rises to 40 mt (from 28-30), up to 60 mt with railway's own doubling.
FY27 volume guidance of 60 million tonnes (NMDC ~58.5 mt + Deposit 4 ~1 mt + Deposit 13 ~0.5 mt incl. NSL).
Deposit 13 to start ~Q2FY27 (~0.5 mt this year, 2 mt next year); peak 10 mt, planned ramp to 20-21 mt in 4-5 years.
Tokisud thermal coal (2.3 mt peak) opened; to hit coal seam by month-end/Q2, ~0.75-1 mt guidance this year.
FY27 capex ~INR 6,000-7,000 crores (INR 6,000 realistic); INR 7,000-10,000 cr/year over next 2-3 years to deploy INR 40-50k cr for 100 mt.
KIOCL pellet to do 3-3.3 mt this year (vs 2.4-2.6 last year), targeting DR-grade (67% FE, achieved 66.5%) for ~$20-30/ton premium.
Expect to spend ~INR 2,000-3,000 crores on overseas asset acquisitions this year; couple of assets in advanced stages.
Expect to maintain EBITDA at ~42-43% in FY27 with range-bound iron ore prices.
Deposit 5 downhill conveyor bottleneck to be commissioned June-end/early July, enabling 12 mt (vs ~10 done last year); to reach 20 mt by end of decade.
Deposit 4 (NCL) commercial mining to commence July (Q2); ~1 mt this year, 2 mt next year, ramping to 7 mt peak in 1.5-2 years.
Seeking CTO enhancement to ~58.8 mt (from 55.4; EC 64.8) across three sites, targeting full CTO utilization again in FY27.
FY27 production expected ~60 million tonnes contingent on SP-III coming online and EC enhancement.
Coal top line of sales expected to reach INR 5,000-8,000 crores within three years.
Beyond 53-55 mt, next major volume jump (deposit 14/11C +5 mt each) expected only around FY2028-29 after ~3-year project execution.
100 million tonne (possibly 110 mt) capacity target by end of the decade (FY30).
Committed to 100 million tonne production and dispatch capacity target in six to seven years.
Expansion plans factor in lump demand falling to ~20-25% by FY31-35; keeping flexible facilities to shift toward fines.
Board-sanctioned ~INR 3,000 cr blending yard at Vizag (~1,100 acre RINL land) to make India's first branded iron ore in ~3 years (2-2.5 yr build).

verdicts.item: Three new manual sidings + RWLS to add 8-9 rigs/day (~12-13 mt dispatch capacity); plants to run at 95-105% to hit 55 mt.
verdicts.note: 'on an average more than 20 rakes... 30 rakes on an odd day' (dispatch scaled) but FY26 production 53 mt - the plants-at-95-105%-for-55 mt goal not fully hit. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: RINL receivable ~INR 3,400 cr; RINL (aided by INR 11,000 cr govt grant) has recommenced payment, expected to liquidate outstanding.
verdicts.note: 'the liquidation process is on, but it is a little slow... RINL has been honoring 100% of their discounted bills' - recovery underway, not complete. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: NMDC Steel to reach breakeven at ~1.65 lakh tonnes/month sales (~4.65-4.8 lakh/quarter); targeting private rake supply by mid-March/April to hit Q1FY26.
verdicts.note: 'NSL... has become profitable' - breakeven achieved (private rakes/dispatch resolved).

verdicts.item: Coal blocks (Sec 7 done, Sec 8/9/11 pending) expected to start small-scale mining around next year (~December next).
verdicts.note: 'Tokisud will come into production this month'; Rohne opens ~Q3 FY27 with no FY27 output - Tokisud commencing, Rohne still pending.

verdicts.item: Nagarnar pellet plant (2 mt, upgradeable to 6 mt) expected commissioned by end of calendar 2025; 6mt upgrade to be sanctioned in 3-4 months.
verdicts.note: Nagarnar 2 mt pellet plant 'in pre-commissioning trials... commissioned by this month-end or... mid-July' (later than end-CY2025).

verdicts.item: INR 1,500 cr paid for 1,167 acres near Gangavaram port (RINL) to build India's biggest blending yard, 8 mt pellet plant, and terminate Nagarnar-Vizag pipeline phase-II.
verdicts.note: 'board has already sanctioned an investment proposal for INR3,000 crores... for making a blending yard at Vizag'; pellet plant 'at an ideation stage' - land secured, buildout advancing. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Slurry pipeline beneficiation plant at head end expected by end 2024 or early 2025; pipeline laying ~70+/113 km done.
verdicts.note: Head-end beneficiation within the slurry system commissioning June/July 2026 (later than end-2024/early-2025).

verdicts.item: Pellet plant near steel plant redesigned to scale from 2 to 6 million tonnes (modular expansion); currently on hold for redesign.
verdicts.note: 2 mt pellet plant commissioning June/July 2026; 6 mt upgrade still not board-sanctioned. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: FY26 production guidance of ~53 million tonnes (54 aspirational), factoring in EC enhancements.
verdicts.note: 'we have touched 53 million tons of production' - met the ~53 mt FY26 guidance. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Market study (McKinsey/BCG/Deloitte) to reorient toward customized iron ore products for +15-20% realization; clarity in 3-6 months.
verdicts.note: Blending yard for branded iron ore (premium) and DR-grade pellets (66.5% FE, targeting 67) - value-addition strategy advancing. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Targeting ~10-15% of top line from non-iron-ore and ~5-10% overseas revenue in about five years (gold, magnetite, lithium, coal).
verdicts.note: 'within three years you will have a coal top line of sales of not less than INR5,000 crores to INR8,000 crores'; rare-earth subsidiary - non-iron-ore share building. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Australian gold mine commissioned (~1 tonne/year); fairly big gold presence expected in ~24 months as adjacent mines explored.
verdicts.note: 'This year the operations just broke even... we have curtailed our production and we are now... going full hog on exploration... planning to put up a small refinery'. [±10% rule]

wtt.summary: 14% guidance hit (14 chains); 16/28 projects on-time; 5 expired; 18% theme consistency (info)
